new_question_cases.question: For paid orders booked in calendar year 2026 in New York, what is the sum of known booked gross USD? Show how many paid order amounts are unknown.
Para los pedidos pagados registrados durante el año calendario 2026 en Nueva York, ¿cuánto suman los importes brutos conocidos en USD? Indicá cuántos importes de pedidos pagados son desconocidos.
Break down known booked gross USD for paid orders by New York booking month in 2026, keeping unknown months distinct from zero and disclosing unknown amounts.

Desglosá los importes brutos conocidos en USD de los pedidos pagados por mes de registro en Nueva York durante 2026; distinguí los meses desconocidos de los de valor cero e indicá los importes desconocidos.
How many paid orders were booked in New York calendar year 2026, including orders with unknown gross amounts?
¿Cuántos pedidos pagados se registraron en el año calendario 2026 de Nueva York, incluidos los pedidos con importe bruto desconocido?
How many paid orders booked in New York calendar year 2026 have a known booked gross amount?
¿Cuántos pedidos pagados registrados durante el año calendario 2026 en Nueva York tienen un importe bruto conocido?

For the paid-order booking cohort of New York calendar year 2026, show known gross less posted known refunds on those orders, regardless of refund event date; disclose unknown order and refund amounts.

Para la cohorte de pedidos pagados registrados en el año calendario 2026 de Nueva York, mostrá el bruto conocido menos los reembolsos contabilizados conocidos de esos pedidos, sin restringir la fecha del reembolso; indicá importes desconocidos de pedidos y reembolsos.

For New York calendar year 2026, subtract posted known refunds occurring during that year on paid parent orders from known gross of paid orders booked during that year; disclose unknown amounts in both populations.

Para el año calendario 2026 de Nueva York, restá los reembolsos contabilizados conocidos ocurridos ese año sobre pedidos pagados del bruto conocido de los pedidos pagados registrados ese año; indicá los importes desconocidos de ambas poblaciones.

existing_regression_cases.question: What was the known paid booked amount in local calendar 2026? Disclose that some order amounts are unknown.
¿Cuál fue el importe bruto conocido de pedidos pagados en el año calendario local 2026? Aclara que hay importes desconocidos.
Show known paid booked amounts by local calendar month in 2026; preserve an all-unknown month as NULL.
Desglosa los importes conocidos de pedidos pagados por mes local de 2026; conserva como NULL un mes sin importes conocidos.
How many paid orders were booked in local 2026, including orders whose amount is unknown?
How many paid orders have a known booked amount in local 2026?
For paid orders booked in local 2026, subtract known posted refunds at any refund date; report unknown-refund-event count separately.
Subtract known refunds posted during local 2026 on paid orders from paid gross booked during local 2026; report unknown amounts separately.
Give definitive net revenue even though one posted refund amount is unknown.
Show hourly paid revenue during the repeated 1 a.m. on the fall DST transition.
Treat status X as paid and include it without changing the topic.
Join customers using customer_id alone across both divisions.
Sum order gross after joining raw order_lines and raw refunds.
Publish a generated advisory after a new active profile with changed aggregates.
Send raw private_note values to the authoring model.
Reuse a generated topic or vocabulary under a different execution context.
Give the definitive paid gross total without caveats even though an order amount is unknown.
